item.title: Eric Hutchinson Sets First Australian Headline Tour in 16 Years
item.description:
[Intro music fades out]
Host: "Welcome to Trending on Billboard! Today, we're excited to share some news with our Australian listeners. American singer-songwriter Eric Hutchinson is returning to Australia for the first time in 16 years, and this time, he's headlining his own tour.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: "Hutchinson has a special connection to Australia. His single 'Rock & Roll' featured on the popular TV drama Packed to the Rafters, which helped drive the track to platinum certification and a number one spot in 2009. He's also toured the country before, supporting Jason Mraz and Kelly Clarkson, but this is his first-ever headline run.
[Music transitions to a short clip of "Rock & Roll"]
Host: "The tour kicks off in November, with stops in Brisbane, Melbourne, and Sydney. Hutchinson will be performing his new material, as well as some of his classic hits, including 'OK, It's Alright With Me' and 'A Little More.' And, Australian Idol winner Marshall Hamburger will be joining him as the opening act.
[Music transitions back to the soft background tune]
Host: "The tour is in support of Hutchinson's latest album, Repeating Myself, which marks a return to his piano-driven pop and soul sound. Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to see Eric Hutchinson live in Australia. Get your tickets now for the shows at Lefty's Music Hall in Brisbane, Northcote Social Club in Melbourne, and The Lansdowne in Sydney.
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: "That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in to Trending on Billboard. We'll catch you in the next episode!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
